discovery: Every Item 2.02 8-K for the 23 already-accepted Milestone 1 issuers, filed in the event window; record every exclusion
universe: The 23 issuers with an accepted Milestone 1 event, no others -- see candidate_universe below

candidate_universe.note: Fixed by the 23 already-accepted Milestone 1 events (config/m1-events.json); not sampled or discovered. Identical issuer set to Milestone 2 steps 2 and 3.

minimum_note: Deliberately minimal, as in Milestone 2 steps 2 and 3: a forward extension to give the Milestone 5 comparison a fresh holdout, not a coverage target. If too few events result for a usable holdout, the change rule of reports/m5-phase1b-authorization-2026-10-09.json applies: stop, record, ask.
selection: Enumerate before reading returns; no performance-based sampling
scope: Daily regular-session previous-close-anchored labels only; intraday events quarantined

window_rule.start: 2026-04-01, the day after Milestone 1's event window ended (2026-03-31), so the candidate pools cannot overlap.
window_rule.end: 2026-09-10, the last release date whose 20-session label window (the anchor session and the reaction session through 19 more) is complete as of the latest session at the time of the go-ahead, 2026-10-08, even for an after-hours release. It is computed from the calendar, not from any price.
window_rule.later_releases: Releases after the end date are not enumerated by this step.

seal.applies_from: the first run that computes a label for an event in the window, until the owner opens the seal at Phase 4
a_sealed_run_may_report: event_id, ticker, release timing, and the anchor, reaction and required sessions
the event's state and its event-level quarantine reasons
the SHA-256 commitment of the event's labels, and whether it matches the pinned one
for each of session_2_close_return, session_5_close_return, session_10_close_return and session_20_close_return, only whether the label exists and, if not, a reason that does not depend on a price
a_sealed_run_never_reports: a label value, a price, a return or a ratio
whether any day-1 label, gap threshold or gap label is true or false
the reason NOT_POSITIVE_GAP_GE_0_5PCT (it reveals the sign of the gap) or any other reason that depends on a price
the times at which labels became available
anything computed from a bar's open, high, low, close or volume, other than the zero-volume test
seal.commitment: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of an event's labels ({label: {value, reason}}), as computed by nre.event_acquire.labels_digest and pinned in the events file as recorded_result.labels_sha256. The commitment covers every label, so no single label can be read from it.
seal.opening: Phase 4 recomputes the labels once, checks every value against its pinned commitment (a mismatch is reported, never overwritten) and is the only look.
limits: The seal is a procedure and a commitment, not secrecy: the same public prices exist elsewhere. It binds this project's own runs, logs, annotations, reports and commits, and the assistant will not seek those prices.
A commitment hides a value only as well as the value is hard to guess; the labels are many floats derived from prices that no sealed run prints.

acceptance: A forward extension for the same 23 issuers, same full review standard as Milestone 1 and Milestone 2 steps 2 and 3, labels sealed; not evidence of predictive power. Completion is the owner's own declaration, in a separate record, as for the earlier steps.

authorization.decision: Milestone 5 Phase 1b, the forward extension ("Milestone 2 step 4"): an outcome-blind enumeration and freeze of candidate events since 2026-04-01 under the same procedure and review standard as steps 2 and 3, labels sealed from the design. The owner answered the provider-rights-at-scale question for this scale with 'Yes, provider rights fine' and chose the hash-only seal.

relationship_to_earlier_steps: A separate, parallel protocol. It does not amend, extend or touch config/m1-*.json, config/m2-step2-*.json, config/m2-step3-*.json, config/m2-combined-events.json or any earlier record. Its event window starts the day after Milestone 1's ended (2026-03-31), so the pools cannot overlap; no candidate of the 23 issuers in Milestone 1's frozen ledger is dated on or after 2026-04-01.
